lines.maoEnglish: “…Miss Akiha, why does Master SHIKI crave so much blood? If he needs only enough to live, mine should be sufficient, as it is for you.” “Yes. If survival were all he wanted, your blood would be more than enough. A resonator’s blood is richer and more delicious than ordinary human blood. But procreation and blood-drinking are different things. Quantity alone can never satisfy the thirst. Every human being tastes different. Once a creature learns to drink blood, it keeps feeding in search of flavors unlike those it has already known.”

Those insects could have only one name: murderous intent.

evidence.mirrorMoon:
"----Foolish."
…… My chest constricts.
I can't breathe.
My self that wants to kill Akiha.
My self that couldn't even understand what was going on.
"Sorry----sorry, Kohaku-san------"
My consciousness wavers.
My body enters a stupor.
For the first time,
I want to kill myself using my ability.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: My self that couldn't even understand what was going on.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: 無神経 is Shiki's moral indictment of himself as grossly insensitive, not an assertion that he failed to understand events. The English turns culpable callousness into mere lack of comprehension.

lines.japanese:
「……秋葉さま、お医者さまをお呼びしないのですか？」
「無駄よ。
兄さんの体は病気という訳ではないんだもの。
原因を解決しないかぎり治ってくれるものじゃないわ」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “…Miss Akiha, shouldn’t we call a doctor?” “It would be pointless. Brother is not ill. He cannot recover until the cause itself is removed.”
lines.mao_english: “…Miss Akiha, shouldn’t we call a doctor?” “It would be pointless. Brother is not ill. He cannot recover until the cause itself is removed.”

"That is pointless.
He isn't sick.
He won't get better unless we take away what's causing it."

　ここは　シキの　部屋だ。
　どうやらベッドの上で　眠っている　らしい。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: …akiha and hisui are talking. this is Shiki’s room. apparently he is asleep on the bed.
lines.mao_english: …akiha and hisui are talking. this is Shiki’s room. apparently he is asleep on the bed.

lines.japanese:
あきは、と声をあげて起きようとしたが、体が思うように動かない。
　体は鉛のように重い。
満足に動くのは目と口だけ。
　一瞬。
　まだ、夢のなかにいるのかと、思った。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: I try to call out, akiha, and sit up, but my body refuses to obey. It weighs as much as lead. Only my eyes and mouth move properly. For an instant, I wonder whether I am still dreaming.
lines.mao_english: I try to call out, akiha, and sit up, but my body refuses to obey. It weighs as much as lead. Only my eyes and mouth move properly. For an instant, I wonder whether I am still dreaming.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I try to get out of bed, but I can't move at all.
My body is heavy like lead.
All I can move freely are my mouth and eyes.
For an instant,
I think I am still dreaming.

lines.japanese:
「失態ね、翡翠。
今日一日は兄さんをいたわってあげて、と言ったでしょう？
　こんな事じゃ兄さんを任せる事はできないわよ」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝るのなら兄さんに謝って頂戴。
私に謝られても不愉快なだけよ」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“You failed him, Hisui. I told you to take care of Brother all day, did I not? If this is the result, I cannot entrust him to you.”
“I am… deeply sorry.”
“If you wish to apologize, apologize to Brother. Hearing it from you only irritates me.”
lines.mao_english:

“I am… deeply sorry.”
“If you wish to apologize, apologize to Brother. Hearing it from you only irritates me.”

"I am………… very sorry."
"If you want to apologize, apologize to Nii-san.
Apologizing to me will just make me angry."

……俺には、二人がどうしてこうなっているのか全然わからない。
　わからないけれど、翡翠が俺のせいで怒られている、という事ぐらいは読み取れた。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: I have no idea how matters between them came to this. But even I can tell that Hisui is being scolded because of me.

lines.japanese:
「……秋葉さま。
わたしでは志貴さまがお倒れになった時、咄嗟にお助けする事ができません。
どうか姉さんと役割を替えていただけないでしょうか」
「……だめよ。
しばらく琥珀は兄さんには近づけさせません。
翡翠もそのつもりでいて。
琥珀を呼ぶ時は貴方も同伴して、兄さんと琥珀を二人きりにしないこと」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Miss Akiha, when Master Shiki collapses, I am unable to support him quickly enough. Would you please allow my sister and me to exchange duties?”
“…No. Kohaku will not be allowed near Brother for some time. Remember that, Hisui. If you must call her, you will remain present. Never leave Brother and Kohaku alone together.”
lines.mao_english:
“…Miss Akiha, when Master Shiki collapses, I am unable to support him quickly enough. Would you please allow my sister and me to exchange duties?”
“…No. Kohaku will not be allowed near Brother for some time. Remember that, Hisui. If you must call her, you will remain present. Never leave Brother and Kohaku alone together.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha-sama.
I cannot help Shiki-sama if he collapses.
Please give Nee-san my duty."
"…… That won't do.
I can't let Kohaku near Nii-san.
You shouldn't, either.
Be with Kohaku every time she's here and never let her alone with Nii-san."

lines.japanese:
「ですが秋葉さま。
志貴さまの容体は日に日に悪くなってきています。
姉さんに薬を処方してもらわないと、志貴さまは立ち上がる事もできなくなるのではないですか？」
「……そうね。
けど、それはそれで都合がいいわ」
　小さく呟いて、秋葉は思案する。
「翡翠、兄さんが起きたらしばらくは学校を休むように言って。
ここ数日元気がなかったみたいだし、顔色が良くなるまで部屋から出してはダメよ。
　学校には私のほうから連絡を入れておきます」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“But Miss Akiha, Master Shiki’s condition is worsening by the day. Unless my sister prepares medicine for him, he may soon be unable even to stand.”
“…True. But that may be convenient in its own way.” Akiha murmurs, considering. “Hisui, when Brother wakes, tell him he is to stay home from school for a while. He has looked unwell for days, so do not let him leave this room until his color improves. I will notify the school myself.”
lines.mao_english:

"But Akiha-sama, Shiki-sama's condition is getting worse.
If he does not receive medicine from Nee-san, he will not even be able to stand."
"…… That is true.

"Hisui, tell Nii-san to skip school for a few days when he wakes.
He has not been well the past few days, so do not let him out of the room until he gets better.
I will contact his school."

「……志貴さま。
お目覚めでいらっしゃいますか？」

「……ああ、ちょっと前から目が醒めてた。
……すまない。
俺のせいで秋葉に怒られてたんだろ」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Akiha disappears from view. Only Hisui remains in the room, silent and still.
“…Master Shiki, are you awake?” That surprises me. Akiha apparently failed to notice, but Hisui knew I was conscious. “…Yeah. I woke up a little while ago. Sorry. Akiha was angry with you because of me, wasn’t she?”

…… I'm surprised.

"…… Yeah, I woke up just a little bit ago.
…… Sorry.
Because of me, Akiha was mad at you."

lines.japanese:
「いえ、秋葉さまがお怒りになられるのは当然の事です。
志貴さまがお倒れにになっていたのに、わたしは気がつかないでいたのですから」
「―――ったく。
そんなのもう慣れっこだろ。
秋葉もなんだって、こんな事ぐらいで学校を休めなんていうんだ。
　こんなの朝になればすぐに治るんだから、あんなに過保護になる必要なんかないのに」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “No. Miss Akiha had every right to be angry. You had collapsed, Master Shiki, and I failed to notice.” “Come on. I’ve done that often enough. And why is Akiha making such a fuss about this and ordering me to miss school? I’ll be fine by morning. There’s no need to be so overprotective.”
lines.mao_english: “No. Miss Akiha had every right to be angry. You had collapsed, Master Shiki, and I failed to notice.” “Come on. I’ve done that often enough. And why is Akiha making such a fuss about this and ordering me to miss school? I’ll be fine by morning. There’s no need to be so overprotective.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"No, it was only natural for her to be angry.
I did not realize that you had collapsed, Shiki-sama."
"----Geez.
I'm used to it.
And what's with Akiha wanting me to skip school?
I'm fine, so I don't really need intensive care or anything."

I do not understand. Whatever happens to someone is that person’s own fate. It cannot be divided and given to an outsider like me. Pain, joy, emotion, flesh—none of it. There is nothing for me to grieve.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Misery is easy to recognize. Happiness is too difficult to understand.
If you measure wretchedness by circumstances, there is always someone lower. If the worst fate means suffering unbearable grief and being forced into an intolerably painful life, then the answer would simply be never to have been born.
But to me, the inability ever to be born seemed saddest of all.

　苦痛を分け合えない他人として。

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
I remember nodding. Yes, that would be beyond saving. Such a person cannot even recognize her own sorrow. Even pity—the one thing she is entitled to—means nothing to her. Believing in the illusion of her own happiness, she lives a life that seems absurd to anyone watching.
As an outsider unable to share her pain, I agreed that if any way of living deserved to be called wretched, that must surely be the saddest.

人より優れた体力を持つ方は、夜のうちに何度も熱をだしたりはいたしません。
昨夜、志貴さまが何度発熱したのか覚えておられますか？」
「え―――俺、なんかしたのか」
「……昨夜の話です。
志貴さまがお眠りになられた後、すぐに熱を出されました。
発汗もひどく、頻繁にお体を拭いて、一時間ごとに様子を見にきたほどです」
――――我ながら、それは凄い。
　凄いんだけど、こうも翡翠に迷惑をかけていると少しはしっかりしなくては、と恥じいってしまいそうだ。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: 頻繁にお体を拭いて、一時間ごとに様子を見にきたほどです

"Shiki-sama.
People whose strength is much more amazing do not have many fevers during the night.
Do you remember how many times you had a fever last night?"
"Eh---I, did something happen?"
"…… It was last night.
As soon as you fell asleep, you had a fever.
You began to sweat profusely and I had to come check on you every hour."
----If I do say so myself, that's amazing.
It is amazing, but I am a bit embarrassed to have been such a burden to her.

lines.japanese:
「……あれ？
　そういえば寝巻が昨日とは違うな。
翡翠……は無理だから、琥珀さんが着替えさせてくれたのか？」
「いえ、それは秋葉さまです。
昨夜はわたしと秋葉さまが交代で志貴さまを看ていました。
　朝方になって志貴さまが落ち着かれたので、秋葉さまもお部屋にお戻りになられましたが」
「―――――秋葉が？」
　口にして、昨日の光景が頭に浮かんだ。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “…Wait, these aren’t the pajamas I wore yesterday. You couldn’t have changed me, so was it Kohaku?” “No. That was Miss Akiha. Last night, Miss Akiha and I took turns watching over you, Master Shiki. Toward morning, once your condition had settled, Miss Akiha returned to her room.” “Akiha did?” As I say her name, yesterday’s scene rises in my mind.

lines.japanese:
……体の具合はそれなりに良くなっているし、外はこんなにもいい天気だ。
　加えて、一晩中秋葉と翡翠が看ていてくれた事は純粋に嬉しい。
　だっていうのに、気分は曇ったままで晴れ渡らない。
「……昨日から琥珀さんに会ってないな」
　顔を会わせれば、きっと今までのように話せなくて困るって解ってる。
　それでも、今は琥珀さんの顔が見たかった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: My body is recovering, the weather is beautiful, and the knowledge that Akiha and Hisui watched over me all night makes me genuinely happy. Yet the clouds inside me refuse to clear. “…I haven’t seen Kohaku since yesterday.” I know that if we met, I would no longer be able to speak to her as I once did. Even so, I want to see her face.

正午を過ぎて、太陽もその頂点を下り始めた。
　体の調子は相変わらずで、良くなる事はないかわりに悪くなる事もない。
　半端に不自由な体を持て余しながら、窓の外の空を眺める。
「―――――――」
　こうして何も考えないようにしても、頭にうかぶのは一人だけ。
　シキという殺人鬼をどうにかしなくちゃいけないっていうのに、俺は琥珀さんの事ばかりを考えてしまっている―――
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: Noon passes, and the sun begins its descent. My condition remains unchanged—neither improving nor worsening. Trapped in a body too weak to use yet not weak enough to ignore, I stare out at the sky. “…” No matter how hard I try to empty my mind, only one person appears there. I should be worrying about the murderer SHIKI, yet I can think of nothing but Kohaku.

硬いノック音がした。
「兄さん。
私ですけど、中に入っていいですか？」
―――声は秋葉のものだ。
　別に秋葉を避ける事はない。
　……確かに昨日の事は気になる。
　けど琥珀さんが嫌がっていた訳ではなさそうだったし、アレは秋葉にとって必要な事なのかもしれない。
　遠野という血族は感応者と呼ばれる者を必要としている。
　……秋葉は親父のように琥珀さんを苦しめている訳ではないんだから、今は、あの出来事は自分の胸の中にしまっておくべきだ。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: A hard knock strikes the door. “Brother, it’s me. May I come in?” Akiha’s voice. There is no reason to avoid her. Yesterday certainly troubles me, but Kohaku did not seem unwilling, and perhaps it was something Akiha needed. The Tohno bloodline requires people called resonators. Akiha is not tormenting Kohaku as Father did. For now, I should keep what I saw to myself.

lines.maoEnglish:

I drag my sluggish limbs back onto the bed.

Suddenly, my dizziness comes to a complete stop.

lines.japanese:
「どう？
　少しは落ち着きました？」
　額に秋葉の手の平が置かれている。
　冷たい指。
　その冷たい感触が、俺の眩暈を止めてくれたらしい。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “How is that? Do you feel calmer?” Akiha’s palm rests against my forehead. Her fingers are cold. That cool touch seems to have dispelled the dizziness.
lines.mao_english: “How is that? Do you feel calmer?” Akiha’s palm rests against my forehead. Her fingers are cold. That cool touch seems to have dispelled the dizziness.

Akiha is placing her palm on my forehead.
Her cool fingers.
It seems the cool sensation has doused away my dizziness like soothing water.

lines.japanese:
「―――兄さん。
体の具合はどうですか？」
「？」
　どうって、そんなのはさっきも言ったけど。
　秋葉の目は真剣だ。
……何か、もっと違う事を尋ねてきているような、そんな視線。
「……いいわ。
私の方で調べてみるから、少しじっとしていて」
　言って、秋葉は額に当てた手の平を下にずらした。
　ペタペタと、寝巻の上から手の平を当ててくる。
「……特別おかしな所はないようね。
なのに体温が一定しないのは私がまだ慣れていないせいなのかな……」
　秋葉はそう呟いて手の平を離した。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother… how are you feeling?” “Hm?” How am I feeling? I told her that a moment ago. But Akiha’s eyes are grave, as though her real question lies somewhere else entirely. “Never mind. I’ll find out for myself. Hold still a moment.”
Akiha slides the hand on my forehead downward, patting me here and there through my nightshirt. “Nothing seems especially wrong… Maybe I’m simply not used to this yet. That might explain why your temperature won’t stay steady…” she murmurs, then draws her hand away.
lines.mao_english:
“Brother… how are you feeling?” “Hm?” How am I feeling? I told her that a moment ago. But Akiha’s eyes are grave, as though her real question lies somewhere else entirely. “Never mind. I’ll find out for myself. Hold still a moment.”
Akiha slides the hand on my forehead downward, patting me here and there through my nightshirt. “Nothing seems especially wrong… Maybe I’m simply not used to this yet. That might explain why your temperature won’t stay steady…” she murmurs, then draws her hand away.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---Nii-san.
How are you feeling?"
"?"
Didn't I already tell her?
Her eyes are dead serious.
…… Her gaze seems to be asking something different.
"…… Fine, I will just have to investigate myself."
After saying this, she lowers her hand from my forehead.
Her palm smoothly glides down to the top of my shirt.
"…… It doesn't seem like there is anything wrong in particular.
But your fluctuating temperature might be due to me simply not being used to it."
Murmuring to herself, she draws back her hand.

lines.japanese:
「兄さんはどちらかというと健康な体をしていますよね。
なのにこうして、突発的に貧血を起こしてしまうのはおかしいと思わない？」
「……ああ。
そりゃあ医者からさんざん言われた事だよ。
でも、それがどうしたっていうんだ」
「当然ですね。
医学では兄さんの貧血の原因はわからない。
　……ねえ兄さん。
その理由を、知りたくはありませんか？」
「え――――――？」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“You’re generally quite healthy, aren’t you? Don’t you find it strange that you should suddenly collapse from anemia like this?” “Yeah… Every doctor I’ve seen has told me the same thing. So what?”
“Naturally. Medicine can’t explain what causes your anemia. Tell me, Brother… wouldn’t you like to know the reason?” “What…?”

"Nii-san, you have a normally healthy body, but you have anemia like this very often.

"…… Yeah, well, the doctor told me that many times, but what about it?"
"Of course.
Doctors cannot know the reason for your anemia.
…… Hey, Nii-san, do you want to know the reason for it?"
"Eh-----?"

「冗談……じゃなさそうだな」
「ええ。
兄さんが知りたい、というのでしたら教えてさしあげます。
これは元々、私の肉親が犯した罪です。
ですから兄さんには知る権利があるわ」
　秋葉の言葉にはどこか―――危ういものを感じる。
　けれどそこまで言われて、首を横にふる事はできなかった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “You’re… not joking, are you?” “No. If you wish to know, I’ll tell you. This began with a crime committed by one of my own blood. You have every right to hear the truth.” There is something dangerous in her words. Even so, after that, I can hardly refuse.

lines.japanese:
「そうよ。
その時に兄さんは、シキに命の大半を奪われてしまったんです。
　シキはお父様に処断された後、地下牢で生き延びていたのでしょう？
　なら、シキは無くしてしまった自分の命の代わりに、兄さんの命を使って存在しているのよ。
　だから兄さんは、自分の命で自分の体を補う事ができず、結果として今みたいに死に直面してしまう。
　ようするにシキが生きているかぎり、兄さんはずっとそのままなんです。
もう、元には戻れない」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “Yes. That was when SHIKI stole most of your life. He survived in the dungeon after Father passed judgment on him, didn’t he? He has been sustaining his existence with your life in place of the life he lost. That leaves you without enough life to sustain your own body, which is why you keep coming so close to death. In short, as long as SHIKI lives, nothing will change. You can never return to the way you were.”
lines.mao_english: “Yes. That was when SHIKI stole most of your life. He survived in the dungeon after Father passed judgment on him, didn’t he? He has been sustaining his existence with your life in place of the life he lost. That leaves you without enough life to sustain your own body, which is why you keep coming so close to death. In short, as long as SHIKI lives, nothing will change. You can never return to the way you were.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Exactly.
At that time, SHIKI stole the majority of your life.
After Father carried out sentence on SHIKI, he was kept alive in the basement, right?
So SHIKI is using your life in place of the life he lost to stay alive.
That's why, Nii-san.
That's why you cannot move around freely with your own life.
And as a result, you are always teetering on the brink of death.
So as long as SHIKI is alive, you will always be like this.
You can never go back to the way you were before."

lines.maoEnglish: Yes. I can’t let Akiha become a brother-killer. Besides, this is between SHIKI and me. If the Tohno blood is truly accursed—if it has toyed with all of us since that day eight years ago—then I will settle everything with my own hands. I will bring those eight years to an end. I will not let that blood torment Kohaku or Akiha any longer.

I will not let that blood torment Kohaku or Akiha any longer.

Neither Kohaku-san nor Akiha, can be---should suffer any longer from that blood.

lines.maoEnglish: “Brother…” At last, perhaps reassured, Akiha lets the tension leave her shoulders. “I’m so glad. You really are still my brother—the same brother who protected only me eight years ago.” Her wet eyes hold mine. This is… well. Somehow, the mood is becoming dangerously intimate.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, I’ll be all right for a while. Will you please get some rest too? You stayed with me all night, didn’t you?”
“Ah…yes. I couldn’t do anything useful or make you better, but staying with you was the one thing I could do.” “That was more than enough. When Hisui told me, I was honestly happy. I thought I was lucky to have such a good sister.” “Thank you. Then I’ll rest for a little while. I’ll come back after dinner, so please get some proper sleep yourself.”
Akiha rises from the chair and leaves the room.

For instance: a girl who had been shut inside the mansion since childhood. The girl who, even so, had given Shiki Tohno a ribbon when he left. And me, knowing nothing, telling Kohaku how happy my life at the mansion had been.
That was what hurt.

As though nothing had happened, Kohaku wheeled the cart away.

lines.japanese:
彼女はドアも開けずに部屋から出て行った。
「っ――――」
　何をしているんだろう、俺は。
　翡翠との約束も破って、あんな真似をして。
　これじゃ槙久と変わらない。
　俺は自分の気持ちさえ抑えられないのか。
　開けられたままのドアは俺の愚かさを嘲笑うようにユラユラと揺れている。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: She left the room without opening the door. “Damn…” What had I done? I had broken my promise to Hisui and behaved like that. I was no better than Makihisa. Couldn’t I even control my own feelings? The open door swayed gently, mocking my stupidity.
lines.mao_english: She left the room without opening the door. “Damn…” What had I done? I had broken my promise to Hisui and behaved like that. I was no better than Makihisa. Couldn’t I even control my own feelings? The open door swayed gently, mocking my stupidity.
lines.mirrorMoon:

"-----"

It's no different than Makihisa.

　琥珀さんはドアを開けずに退室していった…？
「……それはおかしい。
確かに琥珀さんはドアを閉めていたはずだ」
　なのにドアは開いていた。
　それはつまり、琥珀さんと抱き合っていた時、誰かがドアを開けた、という事ではないのか。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Wait.
Kohaku had left without opening the door…?
“That doesn’t make sense. I’m sure Kohaku shut it.” Yet now it stood open. Which meant that while Kohaku and I were embracing, someone else had opened the door.

―――夕食後にもう一度来ますね、兄さん。
　……そう、秋葉は俺に言っていた。
「秋葉に、見られたのか――――――――」
　一人呟く。
　それはどうという事のない事実の筈だ。
　なのにどうしてか―――何か取り返しのつかない事をしてしまったような、そんな不安だけが胸に渦巻いていた。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
I’ll come back after dinner, Brother.
Yes. Akiha had said that. “Did Akiha…see us?” I whispered to the empty room. It should have meant nothing. Yet an inexplicable dread churned in my chest—the sense that I had just done something that could never be undone.
lines.mao_english:
I’ll come back after dinner, Brother.
Yes. Akiha had said that. “Did Akiha…see us?” I whispered to the empty room. It should have meant nothing. Yet an inexplicable dread churned in my chest—the sense that I had just done something that could never be undone.
lines.mirrorMoon:

"Akiha, saw it---------"
I ponder aloud.
That wasn't really a big deal.
So why---why do I have this whirlpool of uneasiness in my chest like I just did something I can never take back?

　日中に晴れていた空には黒い天蓋。
　雨雲は群れをなして空を蹂躙して、月の明かりは皆無といっていい。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Midnight came and went.
A black canopy now covered the sky that had been clear by day. Storm clouds massed overhead and trampled out nearly every trace of moonlight.
lines.mao_english:

「……ほらな。
夜になれば治るっていっただろ」
　体の調子は、まあ八分という所。
それでも走り回る事に支障はない。
　……引き出しをあけてナイフを取り出す。
　それをポケットにしまって、よし、と気合をいれた。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: I drew a deep breath and sat up. “See? I told you I’d recover by night.” I felt perhaps eighty percent myself—not perfect, but well enough to run. I opened the drawer, took out my knife, and slipped it into my pocket. Then I steeled myself.

…… I take my knife from the drawer.
"Alright."  I place it in my pocket and psyche myself up.

……問題は山積みになっている。
　それでも出来る事と、やらなければならない事を間違える事はしない。
　街を騒がしている殺人鬼。
　おそらくは今夜も徘徊しているであろうシキを止める。
「……これぐらいしか兄貴として出来る事はないからな」
　秋葉に実の兄であるシキと争わせるなんて、そんな惨い事はさせられない。
　この体がまだ動くうちに、シキをなんとか止めなければいけないだろう。

lines.maoEnglish: The problems were piling up. Even so, I would not confuse what I could do with what I had to do. I had to stop the killer terrorizing the city—SHIKI, who was probably roaming again tonight. “It’s about the only thing I can do as her brother.” I couldn’t force Akiha to fight SHIKI, her brother by blood. I had to stop him while this body could still move.

「……チッ。
見通しが甘かったか」

　まだ実際に出会った事がないくせに、シキとは磁石の両端が引き合うように、望まなくても出会える予感はあったんだが――――
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: I wandered the city at random, but found no sign of SHIKI. “Damn. Guess I didn’t think this through.” Some part of me had assumed that simply entering the city at night would bring us face-to-face. I had never actually met him, yet I had felt certain that, like opposite ends of a magnet, SHIKI and I would be drawn together whether we wished it or not.

　かなりの確率で今夜もシキが現れるだろう。

lines.maoEnglish: “It may be more efficient to stake out one place than keep wandering blindly.” The alley seemed the obvious choice. In my dreams, it had served as the murder scene again and again. There was a good chance SHIKI would appear there tonight.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: It was terribly hot. Each breath scorched my lungs as though I had swallowed fire. The place burned like high summer. Perhaps that was why I could hear the reed warbler tonight, though the night itself was bitterly cold.

lines.japanese:
蛇苺の実でしきつめられた野原。
　その中で、一際アカイ目があった。
　見知らぬ他人が野原に立っている。
　そいつは一つ目だった。
　目は赤く光っている。
　空に虚が孔いたかと思うほど、まわりのモノとは異質すぎる存在色。
　独眼であるが故に、その色は倍化するのか。
　そいつの目に比べれば、野原の鮮血は気の抜けた山吹にすぎないだろう。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: The field was paved with mock strawberries. Amid them shone one eye redder than all the rest. A stranger stood there, a one-eyed man whose single eye glowed crimson. Its color was so alien to everything around it that it seemed a hole had opened in the sky. Perhaps having only one eye doubled the force of that color. Beside it, the fresh blood covering the field was no more than washed-out yellow ocher.

Beside it, the fresh blood covering the field was no more than washed-out yellow ocher.
lines.mirrorMoon:

In the middle, a single, bright red eye.
A stranger is standing in the field.
It only has one eye.
The eye shines with red light.
Looking like it's floating in empty air, its very existence screams abnormally.
Since there is only one eye, its color doubles?
Compared to that eye, the fresh blood seems like the chrome yellow of a far-off mountain.

　七夜では紅赤朱と口伝される。
　くれないせきしゅ。
　一言にいえば極めて旧い、先祖還りを起こした混血の事を指す。
　小我としてのリセイが大我としてのリセイに飲まれて正気ではなくなってしまった者の事だ。

lines.maoEnglish: A red more scarlet than red. Among the Nanaya, it was a name handed down as Crimson Vermilion. Put simply, it referred to an ancient mixed-blood overcome by atavism: one whose individual mind had been swallowed by the reason of the greater self, leaving them insane.

　そいつは狂ったようにワラッテいた。

He vanished as though the thicket had devoured him.

　可哀相に。
　アイツは背中でゆらめいていた蜃気楼に憑かれて、いつか疲れて、あんなふうになってしまったのだろう。
　アイツは強そうだったけど、同時にとても危うく見えた。
　アレでは長く生きられないな、と結論を出して、森の奥へと進んでいった。

lines.maoEnglish: As I left the field behind, I thought of that red stranger. Poor thing. The mirage flickering at his back must have possessed him; eventually it had worn him down and reduced him to that. He looked powerful, but terribly fragile as well. He would not live long. Having reached that conclusion, I continued into the depths of the forest.

How pitiful.
When did it become so tired and hazy like that?
It seemed incredibly strong, but at the same time, very fragile.
After finding out that it doesn't have much longer to live, I continue towards the heart of the forest.

lines.maoEnglish: Sunlight through the window woke me. “Hot…” My nightclothes were soaked, as though I had run another fever in my sleep. What a strange dream. It felt like being shown one of those ancient silent comedies—I hardly knew the genre, but the kind where a mustached actor in a black bowler hat suffers one disaster after another.

　体が動かない。
「なっ……動かないって、どうして！？」
　歯を食いしばって体に力をこめる。
　力みすぎて頭に血が上って、軽い眩暈が起きるぐらいまで努力して、ようやく上半身を起こせた。
「ぁ………あ、つ…………」
　体中が熱い。
「くそ……昨日より、悪くなってる……」
　昨日はただ全身が重いだけだった。
なのに今は、腕を動かすなんて事さえ辛い。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “What…?” My body would not move. “Why? What do you mean, it won’t move!?” I clenched my teeth and forced strength into every muscle. Now it was an effort just to move one arm.

My body screamed, but that meant nothing. I could not think. I refused to think any further—not until I heard the truth from Akiha herself.

lines.japanese:
走る。
　東館の奥、秋葉のいる部屋へと走る。
　息を乱して、半狂乱になって、ノックもせずに重い両開きの扉を開けた。
「はぁ――――はあ、は――――」
　部屋を見渡す。
　秋葉は――――俺を見るなり、優雅に椅子から腰をあげた。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
I ran. I ran to Akiha’s room at the far end of the east wing. Gasping, half frantic, I threw open the heavy double doors without knocking.
“Hah…hah…” I swept my gaze across the room. The moment she saw me, Akiha rose gracefully from her chair.
lines.mao_english:

“Hah…hah…” I swept my gaze across the room. The moment she saw me, Akiha rose gracefully from her chair.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Running.
Running toward her room at the east end of the mansion.
Breathing wildly, I open her heavy double door without knocking.
*pant*----*pant*, *pant*----
I look around the room.
Akiha----elegantly gets up from her chair as soon as she sees me.

lines.japanese:
「どうしたんですか兄さん。
ノックもしないで部屋に入ってくるなんて失礼ですよ」
「は――――――あ」
　乱れた呼吸を整えて秋葉を凝視する。
　いや、自分でも意識していないが俺は秋葉を睨んでいるんだろう。
　害意をこめた視線を受けて、秋葉は何かを察したようだった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Brother? It’s terribly rude to enter someone’s room without knocking.” “Hah…” I brought my ragged breathing under control and fixed my eyes on her. No—even if I had not realized it, I must have been glaring.
Meeting the hostility in my gaze, Akiha seemed to understand.

lines.japanese:
「兄さん………？
　何かあったんですか？」
「――――――――」
　一度だけ深呼吸をして、乱れた呼吸を正した。
　胸の動悸を抑えて、秋葉を睨んだまま、口を開けた。
「――――秋葉。
どういう、事だ」
　秋葉の顔がこわばる。
　……その言葉だけで俺が何を聞きたいのか悟ったのか。
　秋葉は無言で俺を見つめた後、くるりと、何事もなかったように窓際まで歩き出した。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother…? Has something happened?” “…” I took one deep breath and steadied myself. Suppressing the pounding in my chest, I kept my glare fixed on Akiha and opened my mouth.
“Akiha…what is going on?”
Akiha’s face stiffened. Had those few words told her exactly what I wanted to know? She watched me in silence, then turned and walked toward the window as though nothing were amiss.

lines.japanese:
外は深空。
　茜に染まった陽射しが、空とこの部屋を燃え上がらせる。
　その中で、三日前の夕暮れと同じように、秋葉は紅の空を背にして振り返った。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: Outside, the sky was fathomless. Madder-red sunlight set both heaven and room ablaze. As she had at sunset three days before, Akiha turned with the crimson sky at her back.
lines.mao_english: Outside, the sky was fathomless. Madder-red sunlight set both heaven and room ablaze. As she had at sunset three days before, Akiha turned with the crimson sky at her back.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The deep sky.
The red rays of sun glaring through the sky and into the room.
Like three days ago, she turns her back to the crimson sky.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「そんな聞き方じゃ何の事だか解らないわ、兄さん。
もう少し具体的に言ってくれない？」
「――――――」
　刹那、眩暈がした。
　目の錯覚なのか、秋葉のまわりに靄のようなモノが見えた。
―――危うい、と感じさせる空気。
　背後にあんな、燃えるような空があるせいだ。
　秋葉の髪が真紅に見えて、ギシリと、全身の機構が軋む。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “I can’t possibly know what you mean when you ask like that, Brother. Couldn’t you be more specific?” “…” Dizziness struck. Perhaps it was only an illusion, but something like haze wavered around Akiha. The air itself warned me of danger. It had to be the burning sky behind her. Her hair looked scarlet, and every mechanism in my body creaked.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “Brother? Silence won’t get us anywhere. Or have you decided, even now, to pretend nothing happened and return to your room?” Akiha gave a soft, amused laugh. And with that, I knew beyond doubt that she had deceived me.

lines.japanese:
「秋葉、なんで―――」
「なんでシキを殺したのかなら、理由は解っているでしょう。
　私は遠野家の当主です。
その役目は遠野よりのモノになってしまった一族の処理が第一だもの。
　私がシキを殺すのは一族の総意だし、兄さんだってシキを殺したがっていたじゃない」
　ぞわり、と全身が総毛立つ。
―――なんだ。
　今、目の前にいるのは誰だ。
　この、見ているだけで息が止まりそうな重圧は誰のものだ。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, why—” “If you’re asking why I killed SHIKI, you already know. I am the head of the Tohno family. My foremost duty is to dispose of those among us who become more Tohno than human. Killing SHIKI was the will of the entire family—and you wanted him dead too, didn’t you?” Every hair on my body rose.
What was this? Who stood before me now? Whose presence was this, so crushing that merely looking at her threatened to stop my breath?

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “No. That isn’t what I mean.” “Oh? Then there’s no problem. Disposing of something inhuman is hardly a crime. Even a pet dog must be put down once it bites a person. What I did was no different.” “I said that isn’t it! I want to know why you hid it from me!”

そういう事なら、私は頷くしかないんだけど」
　秋葉の周囲がゆらぐ。
　蜃気楼のようにゆれるカーテン。
　赤い、夕暮れに染まった長い髪。
　ギシリ、と。
　今にも秋葉をコロソウとするこの躯。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh, that. How dull. Why ask something so obvious? Brother, asking what you already know isn’t a question—it’s a request for confirmation. If that’s all you want, I can only nod.”
The air around Akiha rippled. Curtains swayed like a mirage. Her long hair was red with sunset. My body creaked—the body that wanted, even now, to KILL Akiha.

Kohaku’s blood is necessary to sustain my body, but I’ve been drinking the same flavor for so long that I grew tired of it.”

I had first sensed this danger in Akiha the day after the dream where she killed me—or no. The dream where she killed SHIKI.

mirrorMoonErrors.title: The source concludes that while Shiki lives, Akiha has no choice but to live increasingly on the inhuman Tohno side of herself

lines.mirror_moon:
Before I realize it, my whole body staggers.
Akiha.
Akiha's sucking of blood.
It's completely my fault.
As long as I'm alive, Akiha has to live as the Tohno---

lines.japanese:
「けど、それもシキを処罰すれば解決すると思ってた。
シキが死ねば兄さんの命を横から使う邪魔者がいなくなるんだから」
「―――――あ」
　……そうだ。
　シキがもういないのなら、俺の命は俺一人が使うんだから、もう貧血を起こす事はなくなる筈だ。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “But I thought disposing of SHIKI would solve everything. Once he died, the intruder siphoning off your life would be gone.” “Ah…” Of course. With SHIKI gone, my life should have been mine alone. The anemia should have ended.
lines.mao_english: “But I thought disposing of SHIKI would solve everything. Once he died, the intruder siphoning off your life would be gone.” “Ah…” Of course. With SHIKI gone, my life should have been mine alone. The anemia should have ended.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"But, I thought if I killed SHIKI it would be solved.
If SHIKI died, then he would no longer be able to steal your life."
"-----Ah."
…… That's right.
If SHIKI is no longer alive, then I could have my life to myself, so I wouldn't be anemic anymore.

lines.japanese:
「ふふ。
それがね、おかしいのよ兄さん。
私以外の誰かがシキを処理していれば、兄さんは元通りになれたのに。
　言ったでしょう？
　私、シキから全てを奪ってしまったって。
私は琥珀のように他人と感応する力なんてない。
奪ったモノを、誰かに与えるなんて事もできない」
　秋葉は心底おかしそうに、自分自身を卑下するように、微笑をうかべた。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“But here is the funny part, Brother. If anyone else had disposed of SHIKI, you could have returned to normal. I told you—I took everything from him. I have no power to resonate with others as Kohaku does, nor can I give what I take to someone else.”
Akiha smiled as though it were all genuinely hilarious, her amusement sharpened into contempt for herself.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Hehe.
But, it really is funny.
If anyone other than me had killed SHIKI, then you would have been back to normal.
Didn't I tell you?
I stole everything from SHIKI.
I do not have the power to synchronize like Kohaku.
What I stole, I cannot give to anyone else."
She strangely gives a heartfelt smile in pure self-deprecation.

lines.japanese:
「シキを殺してから、私は体の重みから解放された。
毎夜やってきていた発作も起きなくなって、気分がとてもいいんです。
　……理由は言うまでもないでしょう？
　結局、私はシキを通じて兄さんの命を奪ってしまったの。
　けど、それは奪っただけで兄さんに返す事ができない。
シキと違って、私には誰かと共融する術もありませんから」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “Since killing SHIKI, I have been freed from the weight in my body. The attacks that came every night have stopped, and I feel wonderful. The reason is obvious, isn’t it? Through SHIKI, I ended up taking your life as well. But I can only take it. I cannot return it to you. Unlike SHIKI, I have no means of coalescence with another person.”
lines.mao_english: “Since killing SHIKI, I have been freed from the weight in my body. The attacks that came every night have stopped, and I feel wonderful. The reason is obvious, isn’t it? Through SHIKI, I ended up taking your life as well. But I can only take it. I cannot return it to you. Unlike SHIKI, I have no means of coalescence with another person.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"After killing SHIKI, I felt a weight lifted from me.
Those spasms I had every evening did not occur, and I felt great.
…… I do not need to say why, do I?
Because, in place of SHIKI, I am now stealing your life.
But, I just took it and I can't give it back to you, Nii-san.
Unlike SHIKI, I do not have the ability to fuse."

lines.japanese:
「……そう、兄さんとシキは共融していたんです。
確かに兄さんはシキから大半の命を奪われていたけど、シキが眠っている時は逆にシキからの供給があったんです。
　それも今ではなくなってしまった。
兄さんの体が動かないのはその為です。
だから私は、今まで以上に兄さんに力を分け与えないといけない。
　……その為には、人の血を摂取して力を蓄える必要がありました」
　言って。
秋葉は赤く染まる窓際から身を離した。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“You and SHIKI existed in coalescence. He had taken most of your life, yes, but whenever he slept, life flowed back from him to you. Now even that supply is gone. That is why your body will not move. I must give you more of my strength than ever before—and to do that, I needed to drink human blood and replenish myself.”
With that, Akiha stepped away from the window stained red by sunset.
lines.mao_english:

I must give you more of my strength than ever before—and to do that, I needed to drink human blood and replenish myself.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, you were fused with SHIKI.
Certainly, SHIKI took away life from you, but it returned to you when he slept.
But that is no longer the case.
That is why you have trouble moving now.
That is why I have to continue supplying you with energy more than before.
…… For that reason, I need to accumulate energy from people's blood."
After saying this, Akiha walks away from the glowing red window.

lines.japanese:
「兄さん。
たしかに私は血を吸う鬼かもしれない。
けどそれはすべて兄さんの為だった。
　それでも兄さんは私を許せないというの？
　遠野志貴としてではなく、七夜志貴として私を殺しますか？」
「――――――――――――」
　返答が浮かばない。
　秋葉に言われるまでもなく、俺は遠野志貴という人間だ。
　今更、そんな記憶にも残っていない七夜なんていう人間にはならない。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “Brother, perhaps I truly am a blood-drinking fiend. But everything I did was for you. Can you still not forgive me? Will you kill me, not as Shiki Tohno, but as Shiki Nanaya?” “…” No answer came. Akiha did not need to tell me that I was Shiki Tohno. I would not suddenly become some man named Nanaya whom I could not even remember.

I don't know what to say.
Whatever she says, I'm Tohno Shiki.
I won't become what I don't even remember, as Nanaya.

だが、体は違うのか。
　今の秋葉を見ていると、全身の力を蓄えるようにギリギリとゼンマイが巻かれていくようだ。
　それは今にも。
遠野秋葉という人とはかけ離れたモノを、どうにかしようという勢いで。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: But did my body disagree? Looking at Akiha now, I felt every spring inside me winding tighter and tighter, storing strength for the instant it could strike. It seemed determined to deal with this thing so utterly unlike the person Akiha Tohno.
lines.mao_english: But did my body disagree? Looking at Akiha now, I felt every spring inside me winding tighter and tighter, storing strength for the instant it could strike. It seemed determined to deal with this thing so utterly unlike the person Akiha Tohno.

But, my body is different.
Just seeing Akiha causes all the strength in my body to coil like a spring.
It's like, it's trying to do something to the nonhuman Tohno Akiha.

遠野も七夜もない。
俺は、おまえに……秋葉に血を吸うなんて事を、してほしくないだけだ。
おまえに―――そんな、シキみたいな事だけはさせられない」
「兄さん。
私は兄さんのために血を吸っているんです。
どうしてそれが解ってくれないんですか？
　あの時だって―――私はちゃんと兄さんに自分の気持ちを伝えたのに、兄さんは何も言ってくれなかった。
　私は兄さんを愛しているって伝えたのに、どうして私以外の女を見ようとするんですか……！」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: “No. Tohno and Nanaya have nothing to do with it. I simply don’t want you—Akiha—to drink blood. I can’t let you become like SHIKI.” “I drink blood for you, Brother. Why can’t you understand? That night, I told you how I felt, and you gave me no answer. I told you I loved you. Why do you keep looking at women other than me?”

I'm doing this for your sake.
Don't you understand that?

「ばっ―――愛してるって、そんなのは兄妹としてだろう……！
　たとえ血が繋がっていなくても、俺たちは兄妹なんだぞ！？
　なにバカなことを言ってるんだよ、おまえは………！」
「バカな事なんかじゃないっ…………！！
　兄妹だから―――妹だから好きになってはいけないっていうんですか！？」
　秋葉の声が部屋に響く。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“L-Love? You meant as brother and sister! Even without sharing blood, we are brother and sister! What kind of nonsense are you talking about?” “It isn’t nonsense! Does being your sister mean I’m forbidden to fall in love with you?”
Akiha’s shout rang through the room.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Bu---love?
But that's like brother and sister……!
Even if we are not connected by blood, we're still siblings!
Don't say such stupid things……!"
"It is not stupid………!!
Because we are siblings---I can't love you!?"
Her voice echoes through the room.

……そんな大声を出したのは初めてだったのか。
　秋葉ははぁはぁと肩を上下させて、悔しそうに唇を噛み締めていた。
「―――――――秋、葉」
「……兄さん。
私はこのまま、人間でないものになってしまってもかまわない。
それで兄さんが生きていてくれるなら、どうなってもかまわないんです。
　だから―――兄さんも私だけを見てください。
秋葉はずっと兄さんを待っていたんです。
せっかくこうして帰ってきてくれたのに、今更……私を、裏切らないで」
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Perhaps she had never raised her voice that way before. Her shoulders heaved as she breathed, and she bit her lip in wounded frustration. “Akiha…”
“Brother, I don’t care if I cease to be human. If it means you remain alive, I don’t care what becomes of me. So please—look only at me. Akiha waited for you all these years. Now that you have finally come home…please don’t betray me.”
lines.mao_english:

―――指を震わせて、秋葉はそう言った。
　秋葉は唇を閉ざして、ただ答えを待っている。
　自分だけを見てほしい、という告白。
　……プライドの高い秋葉がそんな言葉を口にするなんて、思わなかった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish: Her fingers trembled as she spoke. Then Akiha sealed her lips and waited for my answer. Look only at me. I had never imagined proud Akiha would bring herself to make such a plea.

Akiha was precious to me. She had kept me alive all these years, and I wanted to grant her wishes wherever I could. But even so, she was my sister. I could not love her as anything more. The person dearest to me was no longer Akiha.

「あ――――痛っ……………！」

“You do have a strong will, Brother. I cut off your supply of strength intending to make you faint.” Akiha’s hand descended. One pale finger traced a slow line down my back.
“Ah—ow…!”
Her nail dug into the scar on my back. “How lovely. The wound I gave you is still here.” The scar Akiha had torn into me that night, when she clung to me and wept.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
What was filling my mind? The memory of Akiha and her terrible delight? Something about her had been wrong. Akiha might always have possessed traces of that nature, but what I saw went far beyond them. Something she herself had not recognized could only have taken possession of her.

lines.maoEnglish:
Kill it. Kill it. Kill it. Kill it.
“Shut…up…” I fought down the heart rampaging inside me. What the hell had it been getting so excited about? If it kept repeating itself without pause, even I would begin to feel like obeying.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Kill it. Kill it. Kill it. Kill it.
“Hah…hah…” My throat burned. My body creaked. Do you understand, you thoughtless fool? In this condition, I had no chance against Akiha as she was now. If you want me to kill it—if you insist that thing must die—then be quiet a little longer. Do that, and you won’t have to tell me. I swear upon this blood, I will crush that demon beneath my feet.

どくん。
どくん。
どくん。

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“No! What the hell am I getting ready to do!?”
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
The mad pulse continued. Dazed, I was cast into a stretch of time neither dream nor waking, fainting and surfacing over and over.
At this rate, there would be no need to wait for tomorrow. If this continued all night, I would surely go mad before the clock struck midnight.

lines.japanese:
発汗していた体から、汗が引いていく。
　肉が焼けるかもしれないぐらいに熱くなった肌が、ひんやりと冷えていく。
　額には濡れたタオルの感触。
　体をわずかに起こされて、唇にコップをつけられた。
　こくり。
　少しだけ冷えた水が、喉を滑り落ちていく快感。
――――――。
　すぐ近くには人の気配。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
The sweat slicking my body begins to dry.
Skin that had burned hot enough to roast the flesh beneath it slowly turns cool.
I feel a damp towel against my forehead.
Someone raises me a little and presses a glass to my lips. I swallow. The water is faintly cool, and the pleasure of it slipping down my throat is exquisite.
……
Someone is close beside me.
